content.short: Cetus is a concentrated liquidity protocol and DEX on Sui and Aptos, maximizing capital efficiency for LPs and traders.
content.description:
Cetus is a premier decentralized exchange and concentrated liquidity protocol built on the Sui and Aptos blockchains. Utilizing a Concentrated Liquidity Market Maker (CLMM) model, Cetus allows liquidity providers to allocate capital within specific price ranges, significantly enhancing capital efficiency compared to traditional AMMs. This approach results in deeper liquidity for traders and higher fee earnings for providers, while minimizing slippage across the platform.

Designed with composability in mind, Cetus offers "Liquidity as a Service," allowing other dApps and developers to integrate its deep liquidity via a robust SDK. The platform supports permissionless pool creation and uses a dual-token system (CETUS and xCETUS) to align long-term incentives for its community. As a foundational layer for DeFi on Move-based chains, Cetus empowers users with institutional-grade trading tools.
